theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module K M] [Finite ι] [Infinite K] (f : ι → Module.Dual K M) (h : ∀ (i : ι), ∃ x, (f i) x ≠ 0) : ∃ x, ∀ (i : ι), (f i) x ≠ 0 := by
  let n := fintype.card ι
  let V := ι → M
  let W := ι → K
  let φ : V →ₗ[ K ] W := fun v x ↦ ∑ i, (f i) (v i) * x i

  have hV : FiniteDimensional K V :=
    FiniteDimensional.finiteDimensional_pi' K ι M

  have hW : FiniteDimensional K W :=
    FiniteDimensional.finiteDimensional_pi' K ι K

  have hφ_inj : Function.Injective φ :=
    by
      intro v w
      assume h0 : φ v = φ w
      have h1 : φ (v - w) = 0 :=
        by rw [h0]; rw [sub_eq_zero]; rw [add_left_neg]; rw [zero_add]
      have h2 : v - w = 0 :=
        by rw [ker_eq_zero]; exact hφ_inj h1
      exact h2

  have hφ_surj : Function.Surjective φ :=
    by
      let dimV := FiniteDimensional.dim K V
      let dimW := FiniteDimensional.dim K W
      have hdim : dimV = dimW :=
        by
          have hfinV : FiniteDimensional K V := hV
          have hfinW : FiniteDimensional K W := hW
          have hdimV : dimV = FiniteDimensional.dim K V := rfl
          have hdimW : dimW = FiniteDimensional.dim K W := rfl
          exact eq_of_le_of_le (FiniteDimensional.dim_le_dim_iff _ _ hφ_inj) (FiniteDimensional.dim_le_dim_iff _ _ hφ_inj.symm)
      exact hdim

  have hφ_iso : φ.isIso :=
    by
      exact ⟨hφ_inj, hφ_surj⟩

  have hφ_bijective : Function.Bijective φ :=
    by
      exact hφ_inj.trans hφ_surj

  have hφ_surj' : Function.Surjective φ :=
    by
      exact hφ_bijective.surjective

  let g : W →ₗ[ K ] V :=
    LinearMap.ofLinearEquiv (LinearMap.equivOfBijective φ hφ_bijective)

  have hφ_inv : φ.comp g = LinearMap.id :=
    by
      exact LinearMap.id_comp (LinearMap.equivOfBijective.symm φ hφ_bijective).symm

  let x : M := 0
  let y : W := fun i ↦ 1
  let z : V := g y

  have hz : φ z = y :=
    by
      exact hφ_surj' y

  have hz' : ∀ i, (f i) (z i) = 1 :=
